001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.parsers.JsonParser;
004import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.parsers.Parser;
005import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.parsers.SmileParser;
006import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.parsers.YamlParser;
007import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.processor.ObjectProcessor;
008import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigClosedException;
009import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.UnstructuredFileConfig;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.nio.file.Path;
012import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
013
014/**
015 * An Unstructured BJSL File Config for storing BJSL data in a File
016 *
017 * @version 5.0.0
018 * @since 2.0.0
019 */
020public class UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig extends UnstructuredFileConfig {
021    /**
022     * The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
023     *
024     * @since 2.0.0
025     */
026    protected final @NotNull Parser parser;
027
028    /**
029     * Create a new UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig
030     *
031     * @param file      The file where data is being stored
032     * @param parser    The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
033     * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
034     *
035     * @since 2.0.0
036     */
037    protected UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig(@NotNull Path file, @NotNull Parser parser, @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
038        super(file, processor);
039
040        this.parser = parser;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Create a blank config file
045     *
046     * @return The config bytes
047     *
048     * @throws IOException On create error
049     * @since 1.0.0
050     */
051    @Override
052    protected byte @NotNull [] create() throws IOException {
053        if (this.closed) {
054            throw new ConfigClosedException();
055        }
056
057        return this.parser.emptyBytes();
058    }
059
060    /**
061     * Load the config
062     *
063     * @param save Whether to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
064     *
065     * @throws IOException On load error
066     * @since 1.3.0
067     */
068    @Override
069    public void load(boolean save) throws IOException {
070        if (this.closed) {
071            throw new ConfigClosedException();
072        }
073
074        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
075            this.config = this.parser.toElement(this.loadRaw()).asObject();
076
077            if (save) {
078                this.save();
079            }
080        }
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Save the config to bytes
085     *
086     * @return The config bytes
087     *
088     * @throws IOException On save error
089     * @since 1.0.0
090     */
091    @Override
092    protected byte @NotNull [] saveRaw() throws IOException {
093        if (this.config == null) {
094            return this.create();
095        }
096
097        return this.parser.toBytes(this.config);
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * A builder class for creating new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig}s
102     *
103     * @version 5.0.0
104     * @since 4.0.0
105     */
106    public static class Builder {
107        /**
108         * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
109         *
110         * @since 4.0.0
111         */
112        protected @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
113
114        /**
115         * The file to use
116         *
117         * @since 4.0.0
118         */
119        protected @NotNull Path file;
120
121        /**
122         * The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
123         *
124         * @since 2.0.0
125         */
126        protected @NotNull Parser parser;
127
128        /**
129         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig} builder
130         *
131         * @param file   The file to use
132         * @param parser The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
133         *
134         * @since 4.0.0
135         */
136        public Builder(@NotNull Path file, @NotNull Parser parser) {
137            this.processor = new ObjectProcessor.Builder().build();
138
139            this.file = file;
140
141            this.parser = parser;
142        }
143
144        /**
145         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig} builder
146         *
147         * @param file The file to use
148         *
149         * @return A new Builder
150         *
151         * @since 4.0.0
152         */
153        public static @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder createJson(@NotNull Path file) {
154            return new UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder(file, new JsonParser.Builder().build());
155        }
156
157        /**
158         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig} builder
159         *
160         * @param file The file to use
161         *
162         * @return A new Builder
163         *
164         * @since 4.0.0
165         */
166        public static @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder createYaml(@NotNull Path file) {
167            return new UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder(file, new YamlParser.Builder().build());
168        }
169
170        /**
171         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig} builder
172         *
173         * @param file The file to use
174         *
175         * @return A new Builder
176         *
177         * @since 4.0.0
178         */
179        public static @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder createSmile(@NotNull Path file) {
180            return new UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder(file, new SmileParser.Builder().build());
181        }
182
183        /**
184         * Get the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
185         *
186         * @return The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
187         *
188         * @since 4.0.0
189         */
190        public @NotNull ObjectProcessor getProcessor() {
191            return this.processor;
192        }
193
194        /**
195         * Set the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
196         *
197         * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
198         *
199         * @return Self for chaining
200         *
201         * @since 4.0.0
202         */
203        public @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder setProcessor(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
204            this.processor = processor;
205            return this;
206        }
207
208        /**
209         * Get the file to use
210         *
211         * @return The file to use
212         *
213         * @since 4.0.0
214         */
215        public @NotNull Path getFile() {
216            return this.file;
217        }
218
219        /**
220         * Set the file to use
221         *
222         * @param file The file to use
223         *
224         * @return Self for chaining
225         *
226         * @since 4.0.0
227         */
228        public @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder setFile(@NotNull Path file) {
229            this.file = file;
230            return this;
231        }
232
233        /**
234         * Get the parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
235         *
236         * @return The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
237         *
238         * @since 4.0.0
239         */
240        public @NotNull Parser getParser() {
241            return this.parser;
242        }
243
244        /**
245         * Set the parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
246         *
247         * @param parser The parser/processor to use for parsing and serialization
248         *
249         * @return Self for chaining
250         *
251         * @since 4.0.0
252         */
253        public @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig.Builder setParser(@NotNull Parser parser) {
254            this.parser = parser;
255            return this;
256        }
257
258        /**
259         * Creating a new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig}
260         *
261         * @return A new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.bjsl.UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig}
262         *
263         * @since 4.0.0
264         */
265        public @NotNull UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig build() {
266            return new UnstructuredBJSLFileConfig(this.file, this.parser, this.processor);
267        }
268    }
269}
